metadata.title: Urban Hip-Hop Album Cover with Gold Foil Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban music cover featuring a central portrait collage overlaid on a large, desaturated background face with heavy gold-textured display typography.
triggerTerms: hip hop mixtape collage with gold chains

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, dramatic composition featuring a central trio of male portraits in sharp focus, layered over a large, faded background face. The design is anchored by heavy, gold-textured block lettering and multiple gold chains, set against a deep black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central trio of portraits as the primary focal point
Large desaturated background face providing depth and scale
Gold foil typography and jewelry creating high-value contrast
Symmetrical vertical alignment of text and subjects
coreInvariants: High-contrast gold texture on primary display text
Deep black background with low-key lighting
Symmetrical composition centered on a vertical axis

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three portraits clustered in the lower center; one large face filling the upper two-thirds of the frame in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central gold-textured title and the large gold pendant at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the gold title, moves down through the central portraits to the jewelry, then expands to the background face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the top and sides to emphasize the central vertical column.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright, reflective gold elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses ultra-bold, wide slab serifs with a distressed gold foil texture
Secondary text uses clean, high-contrast condensed sans-serifs
Roman numerals are integrated as vertical bars behind the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are tightly tracked and given a 3D beveled appearance with internal gold leaf texturing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy textured display type paired with clean, wide-tracked metadata fonts for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the display title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, high-contrast collage. In the background, a large, desaturated face in low-key lighting. In the foreground center, three male portraits with sharp lighting, wearing multiple heavy gold chains and pendants. The background should be solid black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, centered slab-serif title with a beveled gold foil texture. Add two vertical gold bars behind the title. Place clean, white, wide-tracked sans-serif text at the very top and bottom edges. Include a standard parental advisory logo in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the gold texture reflective and beveled?
Is the background face desaturated compared to the foreground portraits?
Are the gold chains sharp and high-contrast?

avoid: Flat yellow instead of gold texture

postGenerationChecks: Check that the gold foil has a 3D beveled appearance
Ensure the parental advisory logo is legible but not dominant
Verify the vertical alignment of all central elements
Confirm the background face does not obscure the foreground portraits
Check that the gold chains have realistic highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait Collage + Gold Foil Slab Serif + Black Background + Symmetrical Hierarchy
